A total of 17 teams have been confirmed to compete in the season after [[Alianza Atlético]] were reinstated in the first division following their relegation in [[2011 Torneo Descentralizado|2011]].{{cite web|title=Descentralizado 2015: así se jugará torneo del fútbol peruano|url=http://elcomercio.pe/deporte-total/futbol-peruano/descentralizado-2015-asi-se-jugara-torneo-futbol-peruano-noticia-1783586|website=elcomercio.pe|access-date=9 January 2015|language=es}} ==Competition modus== The competition will be played with 17 teams after the restitution of [[Alianza Atlético]]'s place in the first division. The championship will be divided into several stages. {| class="wikitable" |- ! Tournament !! Stage !! Dates !! Rounds |- | rowspan=3|Torneo del Inca || Group stage || align=center|6 February – 5 April || align=center|10 |- | Semi-finals || align=center|11 – 19 April || align=center|2 |- | Final || align=center|26 April || align=center|1 |- | Torneo Apertura || Single stage || align=center|1 May – 23 August || align=center|17 |- | Torneo Clausura || Single stage ||align=center|30 August – 29 November || align=center|17 |- | rowspan=3|Playoffs || Semi-finals || align=center|{{small|Dates TBA}} || align=center|2 |- | Third place match || align=center|{{small|Dates TBA}} || align=center|2 |- | Finals || align=center|{{small|Dates TBA}} || align=center|2 |} The first tournament to be played will be the [[2015 Torneo del Inca]]—played by the 17 teams in 3 groups. Subsequently, the Torneo Apertura will have all teams play each other once either home or away while the Torneo Clausura will repeat those matches but reversing the home or away ground. The winners of these three tournaments will advance to the semi-finals of the playoff phase at the end of the season granted they each finish at least eighth in the aggregate table or above. The aggregate table will consist of the results of only the Torneo Apertura and Torneo Clausura. The fourth team to advance to the semi-finals will be the best placed team in the aggregate table that did not win any of the three tournaments. Should one team win two of the three tournaments, they will automatically advance to the finals of the playoff phase and the semi-finals will be played by the team that won the remaining tournament and the best placed team on the aggregate table. Should one team win all three tournaments they will automatically become season champions. The aggregate table will also determine the three teams to be relegated at the end of the season. The teams that qualify for the international competitions will be: {| class="wikitable" |- ! Competition !! Enter competition !! Achievement !! {{clear}} ==Torneo del Inca== {{main|2015 Torneo del Inca}} The [[Torneo del Inca]] was the first major phase of the overall season. Although the previous season's Torneo del Inca was not part of the national championship, this season the Torneo del Inca's champion could advance to the [[#Playoff phase|playoffs]] if they finish in the top eight of the Torneo Descentralizado's [[#Aggregate table|aggregate table]]. The Torneo del Inca was divided into 3 stages. The first stage was a group stage, the second stage was the semifinals played over two legs, and the third stage was the final. [[Club Deportivo Universidad César Vallejo|Universidad César Vallejo]] defeated [[Alianza Lima]] in the final. ==Torneo Apertura== ===Standings=== {{#invoke:Sports table|main|style=WDL
